explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/367, first question: with B₂(n) the 2-full part of n (n divided by the product of primes dividing n exactly once), is ∏_{n ≤ m < n+k} B₂(m) ≪ n^{2+o(1)} for every fixed k ≥ 1? In Lean B 2 m = ∏ over primes p with v_p(m) ≥ 2 of p^{v_p(m)}, which equals the 2-full part, and the statement gives, for each k ≥ 1, a function e = o(1) with the product ≤ n^{2+e(n)} eventually — the standard encoding of n^{2+o(1)} (the implied constant is absorbed into the o(1) exponent). Faithful (positive form of the yes/no question).
